note: People layer graybox (brief 010 E; brief 005: people are capsules with a colour block by job). A person is a capsule body in the job's colour block with an ivory head, 1.75 m tall (53 px at play zoom 14, pitch 38, 1080p). Every colour names a material of the civic look palette (contracts/world/civic-look.json palette.materials); no colour needs distance from the signals (Sky dropped the signal-colour reservation on 2026-10-16: signals stay readable by drawing unlit and emissive with their own shape or motion cue, so red, amber and violet are free for the world). A block key the people file uses and this file lacks is rejected. People inside (at work behind a door, or at home) are not drawn (exteriors only); their place shows an `inside: N` counter. Latch tunes; Forma's figures replace the capsules.
